snippet.title: Cartomantic | Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist and join the playtest here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2219850/Cartomantic/

A tactical Tarot roguelite deckbuilder, where positioning matters just as much as the cards themselves. 

Craft decks of Minor and Major Arcana, create powerful combos, make your power reach the millions, and overcome the formidable Arcana Trials to see what lies within.
